intro: Kiribati is spread over 3.5 million km² of ocean, the only country in all four hemispheres.

chapters.title: Micronesian settlers
text: Micronesian people settled the Gilbert Islands around 2,000 or more years ago. 'Kiribati' (pronounced 'Kiribas') is the local form of 'Gilberts'.

chapters.title: Gilbert Islands and war
text: Britain ruled the Gilbert and Ellice Islands. In 1943 US and Japanese forces fought the bloody Battle of Tarawa. Britain tested nuclear weapons near Kiritimati in the 1950s.

highlight.title: Tarawa
highlight.text: A 1943 battle that killed thousands in three days.

chapters.title: Independence
text: Kiribati became independent in 1979. In 1995 it moved the International Date Line so the whole country shares the same day; Kiritimati is among the first places to see each new day.

keyTerms.meaning: The line where the date changes.
